name: cc-session-launcher
title: Claude Code Sessions
description: List Claude Code sessions active in the last few days and jump back into them in the Claude desktop app.
author: ricardoteixeira

commands.name: recent-sessions
commands.title: Recent Claude Sessions
commands.subtitle: Claude Code
commands.description: Claude Code sessions with recent activity, grouped by repo. Jump back into the desktop app or resume in a terminal.

commands.name: menu-bar-sessions
commands.title: Claude Sessions in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Claude Code
commands.description: Recent Claude Code sessions in the menu bar. Click one to open it in the Claude desktop app, right-click to mark it completed, hold ⌥ to resume it in a terminal.

preferences.name: defaultDays
preferences.title: Default Window
preferences.description: How far back to look for session activity when the command opens.

preferences.name: includeArchived
preferences.title: Archived Sessions
preferences.label: Show archived desktop sessions
preferences.description: Include sessions archived in the Claude desktop app.
